conditionsJa: 旧資料の米国例であり、現行の全店舗共通ルールとはしない。
2時間以内に21℃以下、その後さらに4時間以内に5℃以下という二段階を保つ。
reviews.teachingReview: Private original PDF p25 text and image read; selected reference row confirms the historical two-stage US example. Existing independent teaching states the same limits and distinguishes applicability. Only that bounded historical claim is accepted; no fresh certification of the external 2022 current-code claims elsewhere in the paragraph.
reviews.assessmentReview: New independent question discriminates both temperatures, order and 2h/4h stage limits; distractors reverse temperatures, reverse times or replace final5C with10C. Stem/explanation preserve historical-only scope.
reviews.expressionReview: Worker independently authored scenarios, alternatives and explanations after direct private source text/visual review. Preserved factual conditions; did not reproduce source prose, recipe presentation, table or image. Self-check only, no expert/native/rights certification.

conditionsJa: 魚種は寄生例であり、一覧外であることだけで安全を保証しない。
一覧外でも下処理と必要な冷凍・加熱条件の確認を省略しない。
reviews.teachingReview: Private original PDF p27 text and image read; the explicit fish examples use an open-ended list. Existing independent teaching preserves all seven examples and warns that absence is not a safety guarantee.
reviews.assessmentReview: New procurement decision tests the list scope directly; distractors infer no risk, no heat or permission for raw viscera from absence. The positive option retains necessary checks and does not guarantee safety.

conditionsJa: 料理本体は当日加熱、たれは前日加熱・冷却、薬味は生という問題中の条件を保つ。
同じ皿の全材料を一律に同じ工程群としない。
